滚动一定距离后出现按钮，点击可回到顶部。.en-us: The button appears after scrolling a certain distance. Click it to return to the top.

设置回到顶部动作的持续时间，单位为秒。.en-us: Set the back-to-top animation duration in seconds.

设置组件出现的滚动高度阈值.en-us: Scroll threshold for displaying the button

设置当滚动高度超过该阈值时，才会显示回到顶部按钮。.en-us: The back-to-top button appears only after the scroll distance exceeds this threshold.

可使用`containerId`和`containerSelector`两种参数.en-us: Use `containerId` to identify a local container by ID, or `containerSelector` to supply JavaScript such as `document.querySelector('#container')`.
